build_mobilenetv2_backbone: build a MobileNetV2 backbone with default widen_factor and out_indices for feature extraction
build_mobilenetv2_wide: build a MobileNetV2 backbone with widen_factor 1.5 to increase channel width across all layers
create_invertedresidual_layer: create an InvertedResidual layer stack using make_layer with specified out_channels and expand_ratio
freeze_mobilenetv2_stages: freeze the first N stages of a MobileNetV2 backbone by setting frozen_stages parameter
review_mobilenetv2_arch_settings: review the MobileNetV2 arch_settings to understand expand_ratio, channel, num_blocks, and stride per stage
